title: Best of both worlds -city by day, retreat at night
description:
Experience Nashville through the best of both worlds-enjoy  all the conveniences of the city and then retreat to the quiet, riverside Tennessee hills. This basement apartment is newly renovated  with full kitchen, two bdrms, separate entrance, laundry, private patio and home to one of the best views in Nashville. Live like a local! 
8 miles to Broadway/Bridgestone Arena
3 m - airport
3 m -Grand Ole’ Opry
4 m-Andrew Jackson’s Hermitage
5 m-Percy Priest Lake
3 m- restaurants/grocery stores/Target

The space
We have over an acre of lush green land with a river view, where you’ll likely see turkey, deer, rabbits, raccoons and occasionally a pair of bald eagles from the back patio. Our home is modern and simple but packed with all of the little extras to make your stay extra comfortable. We live upstairs in a separate apartment but keep to ourselves so unless you need us, you won’t see or hear from us!

Guest access
Full access to the entire basement apartment. Separate driveway, entrance, back patio- no shared spaces.

Other things to note
This basement apartment  is located  in a neighborhood. This listing is not suitable for parties.
